Ulvaṇa,_Ulahaṇa
--Suśrutaṭīkā. Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 132. NP. V. 32. Sūcīpattra 25.
Is this a corruption for the well-known Ḍallana ? But see p. 582, His.. of Ind. Med. III. G. N. Mukhopadhyaya, Uni. of Cal. 1929, which mentions a.Ubhalta of Kashmir of 12th-13th cents. A. D. a. a. of a C. on Suśruta.
